curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with how to plan long drives, what does not work against drowsiness, the warning signs and how to prevent it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for real defenses versus myths and for warning signs versus prevention.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the BAC limits by age, how alcohol affects driving, standard drink equivalents and sobering myths, planning a sober ride, and drugs that impair.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for adult versus under-twenty-one limits, drink equivalents and the drug scope.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on alcohol, drugs and DUI limits.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover giving driving your full attention, the handheld device law, how distraction causes crashes and how to avoid it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for handheld versus hands-free navigation and for distraction's cost versus prevention.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on distraction and the device law.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what to do at a crash scene, the information to exchange and report, hitting an unattended car, and avoiding and handling deer strikes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards for drivable versus injury crashes, attended versus unattended strikes, and near deer versus certain contact.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on crashes, reports and animal strikes.
